title: fix: correct burst token accounting and utilization reporting in dedicated autoscaler
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Context: Customers using Dedicated capacity reported discrepancies between observed burst consumption in the Console and the autoscaler's internal token accounting. Root cause: a race in tokenbucket refill + usage accounting when concurrent scale decisions and health probes overlap, which led to underreporting of burst usage in Prometheus metrics and the per-fleet utilization report. Impact: utilization reports could show lower burst consumption than actual, affecting cost/throughput guarantees and leading to incorrect autoscaler decisions for burst provisioning. This PR fixes the accounting bug, strengthens metrics, and adds tests and a migration note for historical dashboards. Changes: - Fix tokenbucket concurrency: move to atomic counters guarded by a single refill path and add short critical-section around decrement+metric update. - Emit explicit burst_consumed_total and burst_available_gauge Prometheus metrics and wire them into the existing observability pipeline. - Update fleet utilization report to include burst_consumed_total and a derived "burst_utilization_ratio" for clearer SLA dashboards. - Add integration test that reproduces the race (high-concurrency refill+use) and validates metrics. - Update docs and release notes. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce issue in integration test harness (SUP-2048) - [x] Fix token accounting and add unit tests - [x] Add Prometheus metrics and dashboards hooks - [x] Update docs and release notes - [x] Run canary on small Dedicated fleet in staging Related: ENG-4123 for autoscaler policy refactor, ENG-4210 for utilization dashboard work. Notes: implemented a short-lived compatibility shim so older monitoring queries continue to work while teams migrate to the new metric names. CI: one flaky integration run initially failed; re-run after adding a 50ms heuristic delay in the test harness to avoid nondeterministic timing in CI-only environments. See test section for details.
commit_summary: fix(tokenbucket): serialize refill and decrement path to avoid race on burst tokens
chore(metrics): add burst_consumed_total and burst_available_gauge metrics
test(integration): add autoscaler_burst_reporting_test to reproduce race and assert metrics

release_notes: Fixes underreporting of burst usage in Dedicated autoscaler metrics and utilization reports. Adds burst_consumed_total and burst_available_gauge metrics; updates docs with migration notes for dashboards. This is a non-breaking fix but monitoring queries should be migrated to the new metrics within 2 release cycles.
